```{r setup, include = TRUE}
library(tidyverse)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
conf <- config::get()
```

```{r}
unmatched_dataset <- read.csv(here("data/processed/converter_dataset_trimmed_con.csv")) %>%
                      mutate(
                        # sex = as.factor(sex),
                        scanner = as.factor(scanner),
                        site = as.factor(case_when(
                          scanner == "bidirect" ~ "bd_ms",
                          scanner == "mnc_old_philips" ~ "mnc_ms",
                          scanner == "macs_ms" ~ "macs_ms",
                          str_starts(scanner, "macs_mr") ~ "macs_mr",
                          TRUE ~ NA_character_
                        )),
                        group = as.factor(group)
                      ) %>%
                      filter(!is.na(brain_age), !is.na(chronological_age)) #, !is.na(sex)) with  !is.na(sex) is currently in the manuscript

baseline_dataset <- unmatched_dataset %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  filter(assessment == min(assessment)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Create a table showing the standardized differences
```{r}
get_difference_p <- function(.data) {  
  # Global check: Is age distribution independent of group?
  age_stats <- kruskal.test(chronological_age ~ group, data = .data)
  print(age_stats)

  # Global check: Is sex distribution independent of group?
  sex_table <- table(.data$group, .data$sex)
  sex_stats <- chisq.test(sex_table)
  print(sex_stats)

  if (length(unique(.data$site)) > 1) {
    # Global check: Is site (basically scanner) distribution independent of group?
    site_table <- table(.data$group, droplevels(.data$site))
    site_stats <- chisq.test(site_table)
    print(site_stats)
  }
}

# Function to get SMD for Age specifically against the CON group
get_age_smd <- function(.data, g1, g2) {
  df_sub <- .data %>% filter(group %in% c(g1, g2)) %>% droplevels()
  d <- cohensD(chronological_age ~ group, data = df_sub)
  return(round(d, 3))
}
```

```{r}
baseline_dataset %>% get_difference_p()
```

# Age Sex Matching
## MNC
```{r}
unmatched_mnc_data <- bind_rows(
    unmatched_dataset %>%
      filter(cohort == "mnc", group != "CON") %>%
      group_by(subject_id) %>%
      filter(any(assessment == 0)) %>%
      slice_min(order_by = assessment, n = 2, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup(),
    unmatched_dataset %>% filter(cohort == "mnc", group == "CON")
) %>% filter(!is.na(sex))
```


## bidirect

```{r}
      group_by(subject_id) %>%
      filter(any(assessment == 0)) %>%
      slice_min(order_by = assessment, n = 2, with_ties = FALSE) %>%

)
```

```{r}
print_scan_counts <- function(.data) {
  print(
    .data %>%
      group_by(group) %>%
      summarise(
        n_subjects = n_distinct(subject_id),
        n_scans = n()
      )
  )
}

prepare_dataset <- function(.data) {
  tmp <- .data %>%
    mutate(
      is_con = if_else(group == "CON", 1, 0) # MatchIt likes a binary 0/1 indicator
    )

  subjects_with_long_followup <- tmp %>%
    filter(group %in% c("HC", "MDD"), assessment_exact > 4) %>%
    pull(subject_id) %>%
    unique()

  # tmp <- tmp %>% filter(!(subject_id %in% subjects_with_long_followup))
  return(tmp)
}
cat("preparing MNC")
prepared_unmatched_mnc_data <- unmatched_mnc_data %>% prepare_dataset()
print_scan_counts(prepared_unmatched_mnc_data)

cat("preparing MACS")
prepared_unmatched_macs_data <- unmatched_macs_data %>% prepare_dataset()
print_scan_counts(prepared_unmatched_macs_data)

cat("preparing BiDirect")
prepared_unmatched_bidirect_data <- unmatched_bidirect_data %>% prepare_dataset()
print_scan_counts(prepared_unmatched_bidirect_data)
```

```{r}
perform_matching <- function(.data) {
  baseline_data <- .data %>% filter(assessment_exact == 0, !is.na(chronological_age), !is.na(sex))

  predictors <- c("chronological_age", "sex")
  if (length(unique(baseline_data$site)) > 1) {
    predictors <- c(predictors, "site")
  }
  matching_formula <- reformulate(termlabels = predictors, response = "is_con")

  # Match HC vs CON
  match_hc <- matchit(
    matching_formula,
    data = baseline_data %>% filter(group %in% c("CON", "HC")),
    method = "nearest",
    distance = "glm",
    ratio = 5,
    replace = FALSE
  )
  print(match_hc)

  # Match MDD vs CON
  match_mdd <- matchit(
    as.formula(matching_formula),
    data = baseline_data %>% filter(group %in% c("CON", "MDD")),
    method = "nearest",
    distance = "glm",
    ratio = 5,
    replace = FALSE
  )

  matched_ids <- unique(c(
    match.data(match_hc)$subject_id,
    match.data(match_mdd)$subject_id
  ))

  # 4. Filter your longitudinal 'pruned_data' using these IDs
  matched_longitudinal_data <- .data %>%
    filter(subject_id %in% matched_ids) %>%
    group_by(subject_id) %>%
    arrange(date_mri, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      assessment_exact = time_length(
          interval(first(date_mri), date_mri), 
          unit = "year"
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(cohort, subject_id, date_mri)
  
  return(matched_longitudinal_data)
}
```

```{r}
prepared_unmatched_mnc_macs_data <- bind_rows(
  prepared_unmatched_macs_data, prepared_unmatched_mnc_data
)
prepared_unmatched_mnc_macs_data %>% filter(assessment_exact == 0) %>% get_difference_p()
matched_mnc_macs <- perform_matching(prepared_unmatched_mnc_macs_data)
matched_mnc_macs %>% print_scan_counts()
matched_mnc_macs %>% filter(assessment_exact == 0) %>% get_difference_p()
```

```{r}
prepared_unmatched_bidirect_data %>% filter(assessment_exact == 0) %>% get_difference_p()
matched_bidirect <- perform_matching(prepared_unmatched_bidirect_data)
matched_bidirect %>% print_scan_counts()
matched_bidirect %>% filter(assessment_exact == 0) %>% get_difference_p()
```

```{r}
# matched_longitudinal_dataset <- bind_rows(matched_mnc, matched_macs, matched_bidirect)
matched_longitudinal_dataset <- bind_rows(matched_mnc_macs, matched_bidirect)
```
